packages.name: Base64
packages.description: Type /base64 and some text, then Tab, to encode it. /base64 -d and Base64 text decodes it. Options choose which way a plain /base64 goes.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Coin Flip
packages.description: Type /coin, then Tab, to flip a coin. Options choose what it says: heads or tails, yes or no, or 1 or 0.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Compose
packages.description: Type // and a short note, then press Tab: the writing model turns it into a message in your tone, a few sentences unless the note asks for a length.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Date
packages.description: Type /date, then Tab, for today's date. Options set the format and what you type after the slash.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: HTML Decode
packages.description: Type /decode and some text, then Tab, to turn HTML entities such as < and ' back into characters.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Dice
packages.description: Type /dice, then Tab, to roll a die. /dice 20 rolls a 20-sided one. Options set the sides of a plain /dice.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: HTML Encode
packages.description: Type /encode and some text, then Tab, to turn &, < and > into HTML entities. Options choose whether quotes are encoded too.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Text Expander
packages.description: Type an abbreviation and press Tab: it is replaced with the text you set in Options.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Latin Letters
packages.description: Type /latin and some text, then Tab, to write it in plain Latin letters: Café becomes Cafe and İzmir becomes Izmir.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: lower case
packages.description: Type /lower and some text, then Tab, for small letters.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: PascalCase
packages.description: Type /pascal and some text, then Tab, to join its words with a capital letter on each.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Password
packages.description: Type /password, then Tab, for a random password. Options set the length, the characters and whether it is memorable; /password 24 special changes one use.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Spelling & Grammar
packages.description: Underlines misspellings and grammar slips with the macOS checker. Click an underline for a fix.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Random Number
packages.description: Type /random, then Tab, for a random whole number. /random 6 picks 1 to 6 and /random 3-9 picks 3 to 9. Options set the range for plain /random.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Rewrite Actions
packages.description: Rewrite, shorten, enrich, change tone, summarise, fix grammar, or remove filler in a selection.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: snake_case
packages.description: Type /snake and some text, then Tab, to join its words in lower case with underscores.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Time
packages.description: Type /time, then Tab, for the time now. Options set 12 or 24 hours and seconds; /time 24 or /time seconds changes one use.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Title Case
packages.description: Type /title and some text, then Tab, to capitalise each word. Options can keep small words such as of and the in lower case.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: Translate
packages.description: Translates a selection with Hy-MT2 7B, in the same menu as your other actions.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: ALL CAPS
packages.description: Type /caps and some text, then Tab, for capital letters.
packages.author: Ghost Typist

packages.name: UUID
packages.description: Type /uuid, then Tab, for a random version 4 UUID. Options set the letter case and whether it has hyphens.
packages.author: Ghost Typist
